articles.title: Risk-off wave drags bitcoin below $63,000 as AI selloff spreads from stocks to crypto
articles.snippet: Crypto fell as AI stock fatigue and U.S.-Iran tensions weighed on sentiment, though a technical measure hints at oversold conditions heading into the weekend.

articles.title: Keyrock acquires BlockFills trading assets to expand institutional crypto business
articles.snippet: The deal adds institutional trading clients, derivatives expertise and regulatory licenses as Keyrock looks to deepen its presence in crypto capital markets.

articles.title: Trump Media sells Wall Street low-latency access to Trump posts
articles.snippet: The paid Truth API is aimed at high-frequency trading firms seeking “the fastest” access to market-moving Truth Social posts, including those from US President Donald Trump.

articles.title: Citadel Securities invests $400M in Crypto.com at $20B valuation
articles.snippet: Crypto exchanges have increasingly positioned themselves as bridges between digital asset markets and traditional finance.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley’s E*TRADE launches spot crypto trading through Zero Hash
articles.snippet: Eligible E*TRADE retail clients can now buy, sell and hold Bitcoin, Ether and Solana through a partnership with crypto infrastructure provider Zero Hash.
